name: proxmint
description: Use your Proxmint residential, datacenter and mobile proxies from Cursor. Read a page as a visitor from another country would, generate proxy lines with country, city and sticky-session targeting, test a connection, and check balance and usage. Three skills set up proxies in code, build targeting usernames and debug failing connections.
